subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers review/adopt the open cross-repository PR for this issue, or close it and request a fresh same-repository replacement?
rationale: The source-level issue remains valid, but an open linked PR already contains the focused resolver/test change and blocks a new automated repair lane; its stale check/proof state needs human handling.

options.title: Review or adopt the linked PR
options.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh proof, reconcile the moved UI path, and resolve stale check state.

options.title: Replace with a same-repository PR
options.body: Close or leave the fork PR aside and ask for a fresh UI-only resolver fix against current main with focused proof.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh proof, reconcile the moved UI path, and resolve stale check state.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the channel UI metadata path introduced in the catalog refactor and to whether the fork patch should be adopted or replaced.
